uses.title: 1174 · Immediate first deliveries
uses.snippet:
d = delivery.assign(order_date=pd.to_datetime(delivery['order_date']), customer_pref_delivery_date=pd.to_datetime(delivery['customer_pref_delivery_date']))
    first = d.sort_values('order_date').drop_duplicates('customer_id', keep='first')
    value = 100 * first['order_date'].eq(first['customer_pref_delivery_date']).mean()
    return pd.DataFrame({'immediate_percentage': [round_half_up(value)]})

uses.title: 1164 · Product price at a given date
uses.snippet:
valid = p.loc[p['change_date'].le(pd.Timestamp('2019-08-16'))]
    latest = valid.sort_values('change_date').drop_duplicates('product_id', keep='last')
    result = p[['product_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(latest[['product_id', 'new_price']], on='product_id', how='left')
    result['price'] = result['new_price'].fillna(10)
